req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with the same body for the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: The idempotency requirement for PUT /tasks/{task_id} means that issuing the same PUT request N times must yield the same terminal state as issuing it once. Tests must: (1) confirm a repeated PUT returns 200 with identical payload both times (positive/EP), (2) confirm PUT on a non-existent task_id returns 404 consistently on every call (negative/NEG), and (3) probe the boundary where the title field is exactly at its max length of 100 characters and repeated PUTs remain stable (boundary/BVA). Each test creates its own task via POST so the table is empty at start, making tests fully self-contained. Assertions use exact values to catch operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_same_state_on_repeated_calls
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a valid task_id
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='Idempotency Test', description='desc', completed=false
PUT /tasks/{task_id} with title='Updated Title', description='Updated desc', completed=true
Record response body from first PUT
Record response body from second PUT
expected: Both PUT responses return HTTP 200
Both response bodies have id equal to the created task_id
Both response bodies have title == 'Updated Title'
Both response bodies have description == 'Updated desc'
Both response bodies have completed == true
The id, title, description, completed fields are identical between first and second PUT
trace: R-TASK-027: PUT is idempotent — same terminal state on repeated calls
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

from app.database import get_db
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

create_resp = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Idempotency Test', 'description': 'desc', 'completed': False})
assert create_resp.status_code == 201
task_id = create_resp.json()['id']

payload = {'title': 'Updated Title', 'description': 'Updated desc', 'completed': True}
r1 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=payload)
assert r1.status_code == 200
b1 = r1.json()
assert b1['id'] == task_id
assert b1['title'] == 'Updated Title'
assert b1['description'] == 'Updated desc'
assert b1['completed'] == True

r2 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=payload)
assert r2.status_code == 200
b2 = r2.json()
assert b2['id'] == task_id
assert b2['title'] == 'Updated Title'
assert b2['description'] == 'Updated desc'
assert b2['completed'] == True

assert b1['id'] == b2['id']
assert b1['title'] == b2['title']
assert b1['description'] == b2['description']
assert b1['completed'] == b2['completed']
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

create_resp = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Bool Test', 'completed': False})
assert create_resp.status_code == 201
task_id = create_resp.json()['id']

for _ in range(3):
    r = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Bool Test', 'completed': True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()['completed'] == True
    assert r.json()['completed'] != False

for _ in range(3):
    r = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Bool Test', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()['completed'] == False
    assert r.json()['completed'] != True

final = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
assert final.status_code == 200
assert final.json()['completed'] == False
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

create_resp = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'State Check', 'description': 'original', 'completed': False})
assert create_resp.status_code == 201
task_id = create_resp.json()['id']

payload = {'title': 'Stable State', 'description': 'persisted', 'completed': True}
r1 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=payload)
assert r1.status_code == 200

r2 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=payload)
assert r2.status_code == 200

get_resp = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
assert get_resp.status_code == 200
body = get_resp.json()
assert body['id'] == task_id
assert body['title'] == 'Stable State'
assert body['description'] == 'persisted'
assert body['completed'] == True
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
